verdict.rationale: Stagehand separates execution environments: browsers can run locally, in Browserbase cloud sessions, or by attaching over CDP. Browser state such as cookies and local storage is held in a configurable user-data directory or in Browserbase contexts. That gives some isolation from a user's real browser state, but nothing in the evidence describes a dedicated sandbox or test mode, or any safeguard that keeps runs away from production data or sites. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox/test environment feature, documentation on separating staging from production targets, data-isolation guarantees, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
